sources.entry: Vectoree - Hosted backend for coding agents with one project key for models from xAI, OpenAI, Google, Anthropic and DeepSeek through an OpenAI-compatible gateway, plus auth, Postgres, object storage, a CLI and an agent skill, billed pay-as-you-go. #paid #api #llm

summary.name: Vectoree
summary.one_liner: A hosted backend for coding agents and the apps they build, offering one project key for model calls (OpenAI-compatible gateway), user auth, Postgres, object storage, a CLI and an agent skill.
use_cases: Give a coding agent-built app a backend with models, login, database and files
Call xAI, OpenAI, Google, Anthropic and DeepSeek models through one key
Point Codex CLI at a hosted model gateway
Add email and Google sign-in to an app
Store user files and assets in buckets
Create Postgres tables and filter rows by signed-in user
summary.what_it_does: Vectoree provides a single project key that reaches models from xAI, OpenAI, Google, Anthropic and DeepSeek through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (https://vectoree.ai/api/v1), so existing OpenAI SDK code can switch by changing the base URL and key. It includes Auth for email and Google sign-in, one Postgres database per project, and object storage with public or private buckets. A CLI (@vectoree/cli) and an installable agent skill let Cursor, Claude Code or Codex bind a project and create tables, upload files and look up models. A Tool Hub exposes tools such as Vectoree Search, Similarweb, Semrush and Ahrefs over MCP. Billing is pay-as-you-go from an organization wallet, with a $5 welcome credit after CLI login and project link.
notable: One project key with an OpenAI-compatible gateway for multiple model providers
Agent skill and CLI let coding agents provision auth, Postgres and storage
No monthly fee; pay-as-you-go wallet billed per model call
caveats: An empty wallet stops gateway calls; usage requires topping up the org wallet via Stripe
The $5 welcome credit is one-time after CLI login and project link
Pricing per model is in the catalog, not listed on this page
